description: Opens one GroundQuote contractor's interactive satellite map inside the chat. The homeowner finds their property, draws the fence line, picks material and height, and sees that contractor's price from measured footage; the map asks for their name, email and phone first, and those go to that contractor when the price is shown; they can also book a site visit right in the map (the same lead the contractor gets from their website: $5 browsing, $15 with a visit, billed to the contractor only on unlock). Tell the homeowner this before opening the map. Prefer this over get_fence_estimate and over sending a website link when the homeowner is able to draw: it opens inside the chat. Use a contractor_id from the instant_quote group of find_fence_contractors. GroundQuote does not email or text the homeowner; the contractor contacts them.
name: open_quote_map
title: Let the homeowner draw their fence on a map
